title: Erasmus student mobility
hook: The data this week comes from Data.Europa hattip to Data is Plural. Wimdu wrote a short blog post on the most popular ERASMUS destinations. The ERASMUS program: EU programme for education, training, youth and sport Erasmus students are those that take advantage of the Erasmus exchange program, a well supported and organised scheme that has been in operation since the late 1980's. It allows for students to study at universities in the EU member states for set periods of time. Erasmus students study a wide variety of subjects but most use the program for advancing their language skills with a view to working in the international sphere, and it is advised that anyone interested seeks information on the Erasmus scheme online. The European Credit Transfer System means that academic credits you earn in your course while abroad will count towards your qualification.
